decisions.reason: Routine gh-aw v0.93.5 patch release (2026-10-25) focused on linters, diagnostics, and dependency pins. No new capability, lifecycle change, billing, or retirement. The safe-output network-credential change is noted for a later gh-aw reassessment, but the notes give no lifecycle or policy detail.

citations.quote: This release focuses on hardening: stronger static analysis linters, safer credential handling, and more robust diagnostics.
